title: Ninja Dual Zone air fryer £129, Lancôme gift set £49 and Revlon One-Step £25
description: Saturday's UK deals: the Ninja AF300UK back to its lowest price at £129, a £49 Lancôme skincare set at Boots and the Revlon One-Step for £25.
intro:
**Today's standout is the Ninja AF300UK Dual Zone air fryer at £129 on Amazon, matching the lowest price it has sold for this year.** Beauty gifts are the other theme: Boots has a Lancôme skincare set worth £151 for £49, the Revlon One-Step hair dryer brush is at a record-low £25 at Currys, and a couple of popular fragrances are well below their usual prices.

Every price here comes from deal roundups updated on 6 November. Buy now or wait? The air fryer, gift sets and fragrances are already at prices that rarely get beaten, so they're safe buys. The Garmin watch and stand mixer could move a little on Black Friday (27 November), but both are at strong prices today.

deals.name: Ninja Dual Zone Air Fryer AF300UK, 7.6L
deals.note: The two-drawer Ninja most families end up with, back to its lowest price of the year. It's hard to see it going much lower on Black Friday. Our [air fryer Black Friday guide](/guides/air-fryer-black-friday-deals-2026/) compares the bigger models.

deals.name: Lancôme Ultimate Beauty Icons Skincare Gift Set
deals.note: A Boots Star Gift with a 30ml Génifique serum, Génifique eye cream and Hypnôse mascara, which Boots values at £151 bought separately. The serum alone usually costs more than £49, so this is a generous present for someone who likes skincare.

deals.name: Revlon Salon One-Step Hair Dryer and Volumiser
deals.note: Dries and styles in one go for a smooth blow-dry look. £25 is a record low, and it makes an easy gift for a teenager or anyone with mid-length to long hair.

deals.name: Burberry Hero eau de parfum 50ml
deals.note: A fresh, woody men's scent at over £30 off. It's the stronger eau de parfum, so it lasts longer than the eau de toilette. More ideas in our [perfume gift set guide](/guides/perfume-gift-sets-black-friday-2026/).

deals.name: Viktor & Rolf Bonbon eau de parfum 50ml
deals.note: A sweet, caramel-led women's fragrance with 47% off. A good choice for someone who likes gourmand scents like Black Opium.

deals.name: Philips OneBlade 360
deals.note: Trims, edges and shaves with one tool, and the flexible blade makes it easy on the neck. A practical gift for him that's under £40. See our [Christmas gifts for him under £50](/guides/christmas-gifts-for-him-under-50/) for more.

deals.name: Kenwood kMix KMX760 Stand Mixer
deals.note: A good-looking mixer with a 5L bowl, for regular bakers. Ignore the 'was' price, which looks inflated. If you don't mind the older model, the KMX751 has been as low as £180, as our [Argos Black Friday guide](/guides/argos-black-friday-2026/) notes.

deals.name: Dreo Electric Heater
deals.note: A compact heater for warming one room, such as a home office, without turning the central heating up. Check the model on the page, as Dreo sells several heaters with similar names.

deals.name: LEGO Marvel Advent Calendar
deals.note: 20% off, and Lego calendars sell out before December. Buy now if it's on the list. Our [Lego advent calendar 2026 guide](/guides/lego-advent-calendar-2026/) compares every set.

deals.name: Garmin Venu 4 GPS smartwatch
deals.note: £100 off and a record low for Garmin's newest lifestyle watch, with a bright screen and good battery life. Look for Argos's price guarantee badge, which covers you if it drops before Christmas.

body:
## Worth waiting for?

Mostly no. The air fryer, Revlon and Garmin are all at record lows already, and gift sets and fragrances sell out rather than get cheaper. If you want extra protection, Argos's [price guarantee](/guides/argos-black-friday-2026/) and Currys' price promise both refund the difference if the price falls. [When is Black Friday 2026](/guides/when-is-black-friday-2026-uk/) has every retailer's sale dates. Amazon still hasn't announced its Black Friday Week.

## This week: Christmas beauty gift sets

The Lancôme set, Revlon and both fragrances fit this week's spotlight, [Christmas beauty gift sets 2026: what to buy now and what to wait for](/spotlight/christmas-beauty-gift-sets-2026/), which has target prices and the sets that sell out first.
